name: AsterPay
summary: EUR-native facilitator for AI agent payments: agents pay over x402 or MPP and the business receives euros in its bank via SEPA Instant; it also sells some data APIs per call over x402.

Commonworld's own unpaid check: an unpaid GET to https://x402.asterpay.io/v1/market/price/bitcoin answered HTTP 402 with x402 v2 payment terms (scheme exact; network Arbitrum, Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon, eip155:1187947933; asset USDC; price 0.0075 USDC; payTo Base 0xd5f8481D8F25d3966d2010DBf9B47fFbdf745A9E; plus 5 other network option(s)). YourAITools lists the price as $0.006–$0.03. No payment was made; a 402 shows the endpoint is up and asks for payment, not that the paid service works. The probed route is not the cheapest one listed.
methods: unpaid GET https://x402.asterpay.io/v1/market/price/bitcoin (HTTP 402, header:payment-required; no payment header sent)

claims.statement: Coinbase's x402 Bazaar (the CDP facilitator's discovery index) lists 20 resource(s) on this vendor's domain for the payTo address(es) we observed, with 518 calls in the last 30 days as reported by CDP (largest single resource: 26 unique payers; payers cannot be de-duplicated across resources). These are the facilitator's counts, not an Atlas observation of settlements.
